name: Leaven
overview: Scripture commands the removal of leaven from the homes of Israel for seven days during the Feast of Unleavened Bread, symbolizing holiness and separation from sin, as seen in Exodus 12:15-20. This ordinance recalls God's deliverance of Israel from Egypt and underscores the importance of purity, with leaven representing sin and corruption that must be completely removed. The feast serves as a lasting ordinance for generations, emphasizing the need to avoid leaven in all habitations as a sign of consecration to the Lord.
